parsed.name: 奥林巴斯IX81卤素灯
parsed.description: 用于奥林巴斯 IX81 倒置显微镜的卤素照明光源，为样品观察提供可见光照明，常用于明场或透射照明下的常规显微成像与对焦。
parsed.description_en: A halogen illumination source for the Olympus IX81 inverted microscope, providing visible-light illumination for sample observation and commonly used for routine microscopy and focusing in brightfield or transmitted-light imaging.
